Background.In 2005, by Ordinance No.3658, the former Churchill School site was rezoned
from P-Public to the MUR zone with the condition that:"the applicant, its successors and assigns
other residential uses."The Mu Rzone, even with these conditions, allows general office use but
does not allow"medical office"use.The distinction between general officeuse and medical office
use is, typically, related to the “intensity" of use that medical offices bring to an area. For
example, typical medical offices have patients scheduled atfar greater intervals than general
office.Medical offices can schedule patients at15-minute intervals where general office uses
schedule appointments at 1-hour intervals.The traffic associated with medical office use is,
therefore, greaterthan general office use.For this reason, medical offices arenot allowed inthe
MUR zones.But are allowed in the commercial zones such as CB, CBD and NB districts as well as
the more commercial mixed-use districts ofMUB and MUE.
The Applicant currently offers mental health counseling in offices within the converted school
building and wishesto add the“physical"health care to their complement of services.Nophysical
addition to the building is proposed to accommodate this increase in services which would be
offered to their current clientele as wellas to the general public.Parking would be provided on-
site at their current parking lot.
Due to meeting thereview criteria of Section2.2.1.d of the Cheyenne Unified
Development Code, on April2,2018, byavoteof4to0, the Planning Commission
recommended approval of the zone change request from Conditional MuR, Mixed
Use Residential Emphasis to NB, Neighborhood Business district with no conditions.
